intent: Separate the readability goal from the proxy metric that will be used to check it.

metric.definition: A record of observers choosing a role among enemy, background, decoration and UI under fixed exposure conditions. Keep the accuracy rate and the confusion types together.
metric.proxy_limit: A role-discrimination metric; it does not establish overall aesthetics, affordance, or the reading of motion.

constraints.description: Do not claim a 20% readability improvement before the baseline observation and the target criterion are established.

acceptance.description: Record the evaluators, the comparison conditions, the error types, and the limits of the judgment.

note: The numbers and target names are a serialization example. They are not recommended thresholds, real assets, or verified results.
